name: xerces-c
input_api: xercesc::XercesDOMParser::parse(const InputSource&) with xercesc::MemBufInputSource(const XMLByte*, XMLSize_t, ...) and setDoNamespaces(true), validation off, external DTD loading off
scope: XML 1.0 with Namespaces, UTF-8 input from a memory buffer, non-validating, parsed into a DOM tree; attributes reported sorted per element because DOM NamedNodeMap order is unspecified
family_note: Own scanner and reader stack in src/xercesc/internal (IGXMLScanner, ReaderMgr, XMLReader); no delegation to libxml2 or expat. Transcoding goes through GNU iconv for UTF-8 output only. Shares no code with the Go encoding/xml family.

name: pugixml
input_api: pugi::xml_document::load_buffer(const void*, size_t, parse_default, encoding_utf8); pugixml does no namespace processing, so the adapter resolves prefixes from in-scope xmlns attributes and rejects unbound prefixes and duplicate expanded attributes
scope: XML 1.0 UTF-8 input from a memory buffer into pugixml's DOM (non-validating, DOCTYPE skipped, no DTD entity expansion); Namespaces in XML resolved by the adapter, not the library; attributes reported sorted per element to match the DOM adapters
family_note: Single translation unit src/pugixml.cpp with its own in-place parser; no delegation to Xerces-C++, libxml2 or expat. Distinct from the Apache Xerces-C++ scanner family of the first path. Namespace resolution is adapter code, not pugixml.

name: tinyxml2
input_api: tinyxml2::XMLDocument::Parse(const char* xml, size_t nBytes) over a local byte buffer; TinyXML2 does no namespace processing, so the adapter resolves prefixes from in-scope xmlns attributes
scope: XML 1.0 UTF-8 input through XMLDocument::Parse(const char*, size_t) into TinyXML2 DOM; Namespaces in XML resolved by adapter, not TinyXML2; attributes sorted per element to match control oracle
family_note: tinyxml2.cpp supplies the parser and DOM with no Xerces, pugixml, libxml2 or expat dependency. TinyXML2 preserves qualified names; the adapter resolves namespace declarations and rejects unbound prefixes and duplicate expanded attributes. This is a distinct parser engine.

popularity.metric: Debian popcon installations of the library's -dev package(s) (by_inst)

not_verified: Two valid namespace-aware controls are used; the alternate second control omits a processing instruction that TinyXML2 11.0.0 rejects. Processing instructions, DTD, XML 1.1, external entities, large inputs, and malformed input remain unverified.
